title: In-Memory Bayesian Machine Using Vertical Cu0.33Te0.67/HfO2/TiN Memristive Crossbar Arrays.
authors: Baek, In Kyung; Cheong, Sunwoo; Kim, Hyun Wook; Cho, Jea Min; Son, Kunhee; Kim, Yeong Rok; Woo, Kyung Seok; Park, Hyungjun; Kim, Byeong Su; Hwang, Cheol Seong
one_liner_zh: 该文研究基于忆阻器交叉阵列的贝叶斯推理硬件实现，虽以蛋白质折叠预测为演示任务，但核心对象是硬件器件而非蛋白质结构计算，且未涉及结构预测、构象采样等蛋白质结构建模方法，仅作为应用示例，与课题关系较弱。
abstract: Bayesian inference is essential for robust decision-making under uncertainty. However, efficient hardware implementation remains challenging because Bayesian inference requires both a probability representation and repeated probabilistic multiplication with minimal data movement. This work demonstrates an integrated in-memory Bayesian machine using a four-layer vertical Cu0.33Te0.67/HfO2/TiN (v-CTHT) memristive crossbar array. The intrinsic stochastic switching, nonvolatile memory, and self-rectifying behavior of v-CTHT memristors allow prior and likelihood probabilities to be encoded directly as resistance values in page-wise configurations. The posterior probabilities are generated through cascaded interpage NAND and NOT operations within the same vertical array, without external probability-generation circuitry. In contrast to deterministic posterior computation, which generates an identical posterior output even under repeated inference trials for the same input, the proposed method yields a distribution of posterior outputs through intrinsic stochastic switching, enabling stochastic Bayesian inference in memory. The proposed method is experimentally validated at the levels of stochastic device operation, stateful cascaded-AND logic, and page-level probabilistic multiplication. Furthermore, a proof-of-concept protein-folding prediction task is demonstrated through a hardware-informed simulation based on experimentally measured device characteristics. These results establish that probability encoding, storage, and Bayesian inference can be physically unified in a vertical memristive array, providing a compact hardware platform for parallel Bayesian computing.
abstract_zh: 贝叶斯推断对于不确定性下的稳健决策至关重要。然而，高效的硬件实现仍具挑战性，因为贝叶斯推断既需要概率表示，又需要以最小数据移动进行重复的概率乘法。本研究展示了一种集成式存内贝叶斯机器，采用四层垂直Cu0.33Te0.67/HfO2/TiN（v-CTHT）忆阻交叉阵列。v-CTHT忆阻器的固有随机切换、非易失性存储和自整流行为使得先验概率和似然概率能够直接以电阻值形式编码在页式配置中。后验概率通过同一垂直阵列内的级联页间NAND和NOT操作生成，无需外部概率生成电路。与确定性后验计算（即使对同一输入进行重复推断试验也生成相同的后验输出）相比，所提方法通过固有随机切换产生后验输出的分布，从而实现存内随机贝叶斯推断。该方法在随机器件操作、有状态级联AND逻辑和页级概率乘法层面均得到实验验证。此外，基于实验测量的器件特性，通过硬件信息仿真演示了一项概念验证的蛋白质折叠预测任务。这些结果表明，概率编码、存储和贝叶斯推断可以在垂直忆阻阵列中物理统一，为并行贝叶斯计算提供了紧凑的硬件平台。
